state.seed_assertion: A DPIA should begin early in the life of a project, before processing starts, and run alongside the planning and development process.

sentences.1: A DPIA should begin early in the life of a project, before you start your processing, and run alongside the planning and development process.
sentences.2: A DPIA should begin early in a project lifecycle, before processing starts, and run alongside the planning and development process.
sentences.3: Innovative technology refers to new developments in technological knowledge at large rather than technology that is new only to the controller.
sentences.4: Recital 91 says innovative technology concerns new developments in technological knowledge in the world at large, rather than technology that is new to you
sentences.5: If a high risk cannot be mitigated, the organization must consult the ICO before starting the processing.
